audioBankFinding.summary: The chunk-66 structured region (DEFERRED, beyond this owned range) is a DECODED N64 libultra AUDIO sound-bank — proven by two embedded ASCII magic headers found independently by the hidden-code and parser passes.
audioBankFinding.structure: PtrTables directory + a fixed-stride record table (133 records, strides 0xA0/160B x106 + 0xD0/208B x27, marker word-pair NN NN NN 02 / NN NN NN 04) + a monotonic u32-BE offset table (134 entries) @0x00429820 whose deltas {160:106,208:27} equal the record strides (132/132 map base+offset->record marker, base 0x423FE0) + the WaveTables sample payload (entropy resumes ~7.26 after the magic). The 128B zero block @0x429A34 and 519B zero run @0x429AC1..0x429CC8 are bank terminator/alignment padding (the latter is the survey-documented ONLY >=256B zero run in the whole 0x301000..0x63676C tail — internal padding, NOT a section boundary).
audioBankFinding.implication: This is strong evidence the entire Section A high-entropy family (slices 1-3) is AUDIO sample/bank data, not graphics/texture — partially resolving the long-standing slice-1/2 texture-vs-audio ambiguity. NOTE: kept as evidence only; chunks 62-65 are owned conservatively (the magics are in chunk 66, not 62-65; 62-65 are likely the adjacent WaveTables sample payload but not byte-proven as such).
audioBankFinding.deferredTo: A focused chunk-66+ audio-soundbank decode run (0x421000..), the recommended next unit.
